name: Novel
description: A novel as a printed book or an e-book: the cover, half-title and title page, copyright, dedication and epigraph, the contents, the chapters, then acknowledgements and a note on the author.

source.name: The parts of a published novel, as the novel-book layout and the Chicago Manual of Style's front and back matter have them
source.notes: The cover is printed only by a cover output, which is a later piece; the e-book takes the first picture of the cover element. For a manuscript to send to an agent or a publisher, use the novel manuscript instead.
